title: Use a restrained nape-supported held pose
objective: Replace the excessive folded waist lift with a gentler nape-supported pose: stable slightly tucked head/neck, body and relaxed limbs hanging below, modest lift and sway, and the existing smooth release. Deliver locally without pushing.
architecture: Codex direct implementation from clean isolated fee4b71f3cde3b3297873addb13e122859f73533. No Claude, delegation, push, API calls or private configuration inspection.

Only adjust the procedural pose animator. Remove the large waist/chest fold and head rotation. Use the exported head/neck joint as the support: sample its native world position, apply restrained body/limb rotations, then compensate the waist translation in its parent's local space so the support remains stable with a modest vertical lift. Keep head orientation near upright with a small tuck while the body sways beneath it.

Retain gravity-aligned relaxed arms/feet and weighted IK release/restoration, existing .24s held modifier easing, .38s landing, native timeline mixes and generation/lifecycle guards. Do not change cursor/window grab offset, input, camera, actor scale, assets, roaming, sleep, voice/cache or launchers.

Replace tests for the user-rejected folded pose with nape support/vertical body relationship checks. Verify support stability during opposite drag impulses, modest head/body angles, suspended feet/hands, no accumulated offsets, IK restoration and unchanged recovery/conversation behavior. Reuse the existing complete live-frame and native gesture/dialog/walking/chat checks and visually inspect own-model previews.

Install only reviewed allowlisted public files into the known daily runtime with frozen per-file hashes/backups, private/fixed-audio metadata guards and exact compiled parity. Normally restart only the identified app through its unchanged free voice launcher after actual-runtime checks. Restart clears temporary conversation. Record technical pass separately from user visual preference.
non_goals: No image rotation/crossfade, new assets, gravity simulation, cursor snapping or input changes.
No voice/model calls, dependency/configuration changes, private-file inspection or remote publication.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The held head/neck remains stable and near upright, with a moderate lift, body below it and loosely hanging hands/feet instead of the rejected deep waist fold.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Bone position/angle and moving-support checks plus own native model preview inspection.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The support/motion remains bounded and smooth, with restored authored IK and standing/conversation poses after release and no clipping/accumulation or input regressions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Animator/live-frame unit tests and native pointer/dialog, roaming and chat checks.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The local daily runtime runs the reviewed pose with private files, fixed voice cache, launchers and unrelated sources preserved, without push/model calls.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Scoped installation guards, actual-runtime checks/compiled parity and safe startup evidence; user visual acceptance pending.

risks: The preferred pickup style remains subjective; show the tested preview and keep user acceptance distinct from technical completion.
The nape is a procedural support point in the existing rig, not a new authored clip or a new mouse anchor. All weighted changes must reset and recover correctly.
rollback: Stop the identified app, restore only guarded backed-up public files, rebuild and use the unchanged daily launcher. Keep private files, fixed voice cache and unrelated sources untouched.
